errors.evidence: The x-axis represents a relative time scale that extends to 1.0, although the data points end around 0.95. Stating the range ends at 0.9 is inaccurate.
The y-axis labels span from 0.2 to 0.8. The value 0.85 is an approximation of the highest data point, not the end of the labeled axis range.
The green dashed line begins at approximately 0.3, at the same starting point as the green solid line. The value 0.26 is the approximate starting point for the red lines (unsuccessful outcomes).
